cross-relative.title: Align at the end
cross-relative.description: Keep the edges in the right order. Match their centres last.
cross-relative.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' D' L2

cross-together.title: Help two edges with one move
cross-together.description: Green goes home. The same turn sets up red.
cross-together.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' L' F'

cross-pair.title: Keep a pair together
cross-pair.description: Spot a joined corner and edge. Finish the cross without splitting them.
cross-pair.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' R U R' B2

cross-xcross.title: Finish with an X-cross
cross-xcross.description: Insert the pair first, then finish the cross. Take the opportunity when it is easy.
cross-xcross.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' B2 R U R'
